dashboard: To drive on the layout you need to create a vehicle in the "Vehicles" tab with a DCC address, then click <addIcon></addIcon> to place it on the layout. To open the throttle cockpit, choose <throttleIcon></throttleIcon>, or Menu -> Throttle
myVehicles: To drive a vehicle you must place it on the layout with the <addIcon></addIcon> button. If the vehicle has no functions, e.g. F0, F1, … — to assign them use <functionsIcon></functionsIcon>, where you can enter them manually or copy from another vehicle or a ready-made template.
rentals: You can temporarily lend a vehicle to someone else, or someone else can lend their vehicle to you. When another person takes control of a vehicle, the other person temporarily loses it — though the owner can restore that control at any time. Changing who is driving a vehicle stops the vehicle.
myTrains: Combine several vehicles into one train so you can control multiple locomotives at once and turn on coach lights in a single control view. Note — global limits on the number of controlled vehicles and occupied LocoNet slots set by the layout administrator apply
